text:
A question paper becomes an online test. Equations, typed in seconds. Students join from any phone. Cheating gets caught. And every result lands, ranked.
This is Testoza — and these are its top ten features, with exactly how to use each one.
raw:
{m1}A question paper becomes an online test. {m2}Equations, typed in seconds. {m3}Students join from any phone. {m4}Cheating gets caught. {m5}And every result lands, ranked.
{title}This is TestoZa — and these are its top ten features, with exactly how to use each one.

text: Number one: Generate with AI.
raw: Number one: Generate with AI.

text: Got your question paper as a PDF, or just photos? Open Generate with AI, choose the file — a three-page PDF, answer key included — and tap Extract Questions.
raw: Got your question paper as a PDF, or just photos? {upload}Open Generate with AI, {choose}choose the file — a three-page PDF, answer key included — {extract}and tap Extract Questions.

text: Now watch. The AI reads every single page, and the questions start arriving one by one — options, maths, everything. In about half a minute, all twelve are done.
raw: {reading}Now watch. The AI reads every single page, {q1}and the questions start arriving one by one — options, maths, everything. {preview}In about half a minute, all twelve are done.

text: It even read the answer key on the last page, so every answer is already marked. Have a quick look, save, and your paper is now a test.
raw: {answers}It even read the answer key on the last page, so every answer is already marked. Have a quick look, {save}save, {newcard}and your paper is now a test.

text: Number two: maths and science, typed properly.
raw: Number two: maths and science, typed properly.

text: Open the test in the builder — all twelve questions are already here. Add a question, and type the words as usual. For the formula, open Maths and symbols — this is Sy Pad.
raw: {edit}Open the test in the builder — all twelve questions are already here. {addq}Add a question, {q13text}and type the words as usual. {sypad}For the formula, open Maths and symbols — this is Sy Pad.

text: Type h equals u t minus, tap the fraction key, one over two, then the power key, for t squared. A proper formula — no code to learn. Insert, and it sits right inside the question.
raw: {h}Type h equals u t minus, {frac}tap the fraction key, one over two, {power}then the power key, for t squared. {formula}A proper formula — no code to learn. {insert}Insert, and it sits right inside the question.

text: Number three: type in Hindi — or any of a hundred and nineteen languages.
raw: Number three: type in Hindi — or any of a hundred and nineteen languages.

text: Tap the language switch, pick Hindi, and just type in English letters. Every word turns into Hindi the moment you hit space — no Hindi keyboard needed. Now the question is in both languages, and the options go in just like before.
raw: {lang}Tap the language switch, {hindi}pick Hindi, {hitype}and just type in English letters. Every word turns into Hindi the moment you hit space — no Hindi keyboard needed. {hindone}Now the question is in both languages, {opts}and the options go in just like before.

text: Number four: real exam patterns.
raw: Number four: real exam patterns.

text: Plus four, minus one, on every question. Need JEE Advanced style? Make it multiple correct, choose JEE Advanced partial marks, and mark the right answer.
raw: {marks}Plus four, minus one, on every question. {qtype}Need JEE Advanced style? {multi}Make it multiple correct, {jeeadv}choose JEE Advanced partial marks, {correct}and mark the right answer.

text: Now split the paper into sections, and give every section its own timer, the way SSC does. Split it anywhere: questions seven to thirteen become Section B. Ten minutes here, ten minutes there… save.

text: Number five: go live in one click — inside an anti-cheating exam room.
raw: Number five: go live in one click — inside an anti-cheating exam room.

text: When the test is ready, tap Conduct exam. You get a secure exam link. Start conducting, and the exam is live.
raw: {card}When the test is ready, {conduct}tap Conduct exam. {link}You get a secure exam link. {start}Start conducting, {live}and the exam is live.

text: Testoza even tells you the next step: set up the exam room. Force full screen. Catch every tab or app switch, set a limit — say three warnings — and the test submits itself. Block copy-paste, right-click, and the back button.

text: On the Results tab, you decide what candidates see after the exam. And shuffle the questions, so no two candidates get the same order. Save.
raw: {results}On the Results tab, {resultview}you decide what candidates see after the exam. {shuffle}And shuffle the questions, so no two candidates get the same order. {saveset}Save.

text: Number six: share it anywhere.
raw: Number six: share it anywhere.

text: Next tip: send it to your candidates. Copy the link, or share it straight to your class WhatsApp group. No phones in class? Get a join code. Six digits. Write it on the board, and students type it at testoza dot com slash join.

text: Number seven: collect the details you need.

text: Name is asked by default. Add Roll Number, or anything else — batch, school, phone. Candidates fill it in before they start.

text: Number eight: an exam room on any phone. No app, no sign-up.
